claims.claim: The only published onboarding step for the PULSE website is a registration form, with credentials promised within five business days; no membership types, sponsor model or application fees are published.
claims.quote: Receive a User ID and temporary password within 5 business days
claims.title: Log In / Register - PULSE
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Three steps listed: complete and submit registration form; receive User ID and temporary password within 5 business days; log in and reset password. Eligibility not stated.

claims.claim: PULSE's public path to becoming a participant is a sales call-back form (name, company, email, phone, comments) rather than a published application; existing clients are routed to Client Support.
claims.quote: Already a client? Go to Client Support
claims.title: Connect With Us - PULSE
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Form is titled 'Request a call back'. Main line (800) 543-3695, 8am-5pm CT Mon-Fri. Houston office 1301 McKinney Street, Suite 600.

claims.claim: The website Terms of Use name the operating entity as PULSE Network LLC, a Delaware LLC, last updated May 1, 2024, and contain no API or developer terms.
claims.quote: PULSE NETWORK LLC, A DELAWARE LIMITED LIABILITY COMPANY
claims.title: Terms of Use - PULSE
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Predates Capital One's May 18, 2025 close of the Discover acquisition. Terms prohibit reverse engineering of PULSE 'software or infrastructure'.

claims.claim: DebitProtect Standard is bundled for every PULSE participant, while enrollment for new clients runs through an Account Executive rather than a self-service programme.
claims.title: Fraud Detection & Risk Mitigation - PULSE
claims.label: Vendor
claims.note: Two tiers named: DebitProtect Standard (included for all PULSE participants) and DebitProtect Authorization Blocking (premier). Existing Standard clients 'Register your users' at /pn/pulse/register. Powered by FICO Falcon. No pricing shown.

claims.claim: PULSE's Side-by-Side token service for card-on-file debit is enrolled by contact form only; no API specification or fee is published logged out.
claims.quote: Available for participation to all unaffiliated, back-of-card debit networks
claims.title: PULSE Side-by-Side Token Service
claims.label: Vendor
claims.note: Form fields: First Name, Last Name, Email, Phone, Financial Institution, Comments. Described as 'patented offering' enabling 'tokenized routing choice for card-on-file (COF) debit transactions, including cryptogram validation'.

claims.claim: PULSE markets 'API access' and tokenization to issuers, but no developer portal, API reference, sandbox, SDK, OpenAPI file or changelog is reachable logged out anywhere on pulsenetwork.com.
claims.quote: API access, disputes processing, contactless solutions, and tokenization
claims.title: Why PULSE - PULSE
claims.label: Vendor
claims.note: Absence finding: fourteen pulsenetwork.com pages read; none links to developer documentation. Developer surface is presumably behind the /pn/pulse/login portal or via Discover Global Network's developer site (not fetched).

claims.claim: PULSE's gateway product exposes a single message format to a named list of POS and ATM networks (AllPoint, AFFN, Cirrus, Co-Op, Discover Network, EBT, Interlink, Maestro, MoneyPass, NYCE, PAVD, PLUS, STAR), without any published specification.
claims.quote: One message format for leading POS and ATM networks
claims.title: Debit Processing & Gateways - PULSE
claims.label: Vendor
claims.note: Also offers full-service processing for 'Discover Debit, Mastercard and Visa debit card programs, all through a single point of access' (PULSE Debit Solutions). No ISO 8583 spec, certification stages, or fees on page.

claims.claim: Processor support is handled through a dedicated mailbox whose name implies a gated Processor Portal; merchant acquirer sales and disputes also have named mailboxes.
claims.title: Client Support - PULSE
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Mailboxes: pulseaccountmanagement@discover.com (issuer support), debitprotect@pulsenetwork.com, disputes@pulsenetwork.com, processorportal@pulsenetwork.com, merchantacquirersales@pulsenetwork.com, pulse@pulsenetwork.com (acceptance mark). Phones: issuer 877-247-8573, Discover Debit issuer 877-433-3248, DebitProtect 866-892-3517, processor/merchant acquirer 800-420-2122.

claims.claim: The Federal Reserve's Reg II network data for 2024 shows PULSE's average interchange fee at $0.29 per exempt transaction and $0.24 per covered transaction.
claims.title: Average Debit Card Interchange Fee by Payment Card Network
claims.publisher: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Page states last updated December 19, 2025, 2024 data. PULSE row: 55.8% of its transactions exempt, 44.2% covered; $0.29 exempt, $0.24 covered. Single-message network averages: $0.26 exempt, $0.24 covered; dual-message: $0.61 exempt, $0.22 covered. This is the only public, quantified PULSE fee datapoint found.

claims.claim: The regulatory interchange cap that binds PULSE's covered issuers is the Reg II standard of 21 cents plus 5 basis points (plus the 1-cent fraud adjustment), unchanged as of the Fed's December 2025 update.
claims.quote: $0.21 plus 0.05 percent multiplied by the value of the transaction
claims.title: Average Debit Card Interchange Fee by Payment Card Network
claims.publisher: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: The Fed's October 2023 proposal to lower the cap was not reflected as adopted on this page.

claims.claim: PULSE does not publish an interchange schedule; the Payments Network page describes PIN and PINless economics only qualitatively.
claims.quote: PINless card-present transactions with highly-competitive interchange and low network fees
claims.title: PULSE Payments Network - PULSE
claims.label: Vendor
claims.note: PULSE PAY Express: 'No cardholder verification for transactions of $50 or less' and 'Cardholder verification supported for transactions over $50'. 'Access through virtually every major processor'. No rates, effective dates or category names.

claims.claim: Discover Debit is sold to issuers on an all-in program fee with a one-page invoice and no quarterly reporting, but the fee level is not disclosed.
claims.title: Discover Debit - PULSE
claims.label: Vendor
claims.note: Page mentions an 'All-in Program Fee' structure, transparent one-page billing, no quarterly reporting, and bill reconciliation 'as little as 10 minutes' versus a competitor's '8 hours'. Links to a gated 'Debit Advantage Analysis' at www1.pulsenetwork.com/DiscoverDebitAdvantageAnalysis.

claims.claim: ATM acquirers are promised access to 400,000 U.S. ATMs' worth of cardholders plus exclusive Discover, Discover Debit and Diners Club cards, with fees described only as competitive.
claims.quote: Offer cardholders access to 400,000 ATMs across the U.S. with competitive interchange and transaction fees.
claims.title: ATM Acquirers - PULSE
claims.label: Vendor
claims.note: Also: 'exclusive access to Discover credit, Discover Debit, and Diners Club International cards' and MoneyPass surcharge-free option. No sponsorship, certification or fee schedule published.

claims.claim: PULSE claims Reg II compliance for CNP routing via PULSE PAY Express and positions it as open to all enabled unaffiliated back-of-card networks; no unaffiliated-network certification or mandate document is public.
claims.quote: Provides compliance with Regulation II, card-not-present (CNP) clarification
claims.title: PULSE Payments Network - PULSE
claims.label: Vendor
claims.note: Refers to the Fed's Reg II CNP clarification effective July 1, 2023. Paired statement: 'Available for participation to all enabled unaffiliated, back-of-card debit networks'.

claims.claim: PULSE's dispute framework is not named publicly; the merchant page only promises full dispute support aligned to industry practices, with a disputes mailbox on the support page.
claims.quote: Chargebacks and disputes: Full disputes support for transactions, aligned to industry practices
claims.title: Merchants - PULSE
claims.label: Vendor
claims.note: Merchant page also claims 'some merchants have seen a 10 point improvement in authorization rates' and 'Debit routing could result in significant savings'. No rulebook, timeframes or reason codes.

claims.claim: PULSE's named fraud/security programme is DebitProtect (FICO Falcon based) with an Authorization Blocking tier offering card-group rules for compromise events and after-hours self-service emergency rules at no fee.
claims.quote: Card-group rules to manage cards impacted by compromise events
claims.title: Fraud Detection & Risk Mitigation - PULSE
claims.label: Vendor
claims.note: No PCI, EMV certification, or network compliance programme is named on any public page. FICO agreement extension was announced 8/9/2023 (news page).

claims.claim: The only rules-type document reachable logged out is the PULSE Graphic Standards Manual (acceptance-mark brand rules); operating rules, bulletins and fee schedules are not public.
claims.title: Client Support - PULSE
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: PDF plus acceptance mark files (.ai, .png, .jpg). Portals named on the same page: PULSE Debit Dashboard, ATM List Manager, PULSE Exchange (all at /pulse/login.html) and Marketing Hub (debitmarketinghub.com).

claims.claim: PULSE's public news feed has not been updated since August 2024 and carries no mandate bulletins, so mandate cadence cannot be observed from the public site.
claims.quote: PULSE® Study Finds Debit's Importance to Consumers Continues to Increase
claims.title: Insights & News - PULSE
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Seven items total, newest dated 8/8/2024; none about the Capital One acquisition, Reg II, fees or processor certifications. Absence finding for mandates in last 24 months.

claims.claim: The 2026 PULSE Debit Issuer Study (the network's annual issuer research) is gated behind a content.pulsenetwork.com form; headline stats are shown publicly.
claims.quote: Card-not-present (CNP) transactions represent 50% of debit spend
claims.title: 2026 PULSE Debit Issuer Study - PULSE
claims.label: Vendor
claims.note: Other public stats: transactions +4.6% YoY, 35.4 monthly transactions per active cardholder, 17% via mobile wallets, A2A volume +25% YoY. Download at content.pulsenetwork.com/2026-debit-issuer-study/2026-pulse-debit-issuer-study-report. Prior editions 2023-2025 linked.
